identity.realm: Stated by her own species record and not by her: the fifth gate is the yin-organ gate, sap columns branch but do not pair, so there is no heart analogue to run a channel from and no kidney analogue to close a loop against. She clears the gate set on stored sap alone and stops there. The wall is arithmetic, not temperament.

appearance.presentation: A standing column three paces tall with a fruiting shoulder that is carrying nothing this season, root plates splayed over ground she chose once and has not chosen since, and a stillness that reads to a stranger as patience and is in fact the absence of anywhere to go.
appearance.age: Old for her species and young by the calendar on the scrub, which counts a rootmarch's age from establishment rather than from seed.
appearance.build: A woody column on a broad root foot, heavier below the shoulder than above it, with photosynthetic flanks that take a bruised green when the light is thin.
appearance.complexion: Bark over sap-dark wood, split at the shoulder where the fruiting spur seals each season, and dry to the touch within a day of rain.
appearance.hair: None in the ordinary sense; a fringe of fine rootlets at the collar that stands up in still air and lies flat in moving air, which is how anybody on the commons reads the weather before the sky does.
appearance.eyes: Slow light sense across the flanks rather than eyes, so she turns toward a speaker a beat after the speaker has finished rather than when they begin.
appearance.palette: Bark umber, sap-green in the shaded grooves, a bleached shoulder where the sun has found the same plate every season, and one dull ochre in the fruiting spur.
appearance.attire: Nothing she chose and nothing she can shed: the root plates are her lower garment and the flanks carry whatever the commons air has deposited on them since spring.
appearance.marks: A ring of older bark around the base where she was seeded, and the shallow callus at the shoulder that closes each fruiting spur whether or not the spur sets.
appearance.bearing: Rooted to the point that the word standing is a courtesy; she leans into a question the way a trunk leans into wind, and does not turn away from anything.

canon.role_in_story:
The Bitter Common has one plant on it that everybody wants for a different reason and nobody wants to pay for, and she is standing in the middle of it. The scrub's herb is medicine, feed and calories at once on ground that cannot be fenced, so the settlement has never solved anything by drawing a line, and it has never needed to until somebody noticed that the herb takes the same soil qi the commons' grazing takes, and that one body on the belt can draw that qi out of the ground faster than anything else on the tier. That body is a rootmarch, and a rootmarch cannot be moved once rooted.

So the settlement has a proposal and she is the whole of it. It is not cruel and it is not stupid. If she roots further out, past the grazing, into the deep soil where the herb gives way to something with more qi under it, then the commons keeps its herb and the soil qi stops being contested and the queue for the good ground goes away. Every part of that is true. The one clause nobody has said out loud is the lifting. A rootmarch lifted from its bed is a stored harvest walking, and it knows it, and her species' record says so in as many words: fire, frost below a threshold, and being moved while rooting. She would survive the walk. She would arrive diminished, and everybody who depends on what her kind was engineered to do would find out at the worst possible time, in a famine, which is the only circumstance the engineering was for.

Her gift and her cost are the same fluid. Her qi is not seated in anything: it is held in three sap columns that branch through the whole body and are distributed rather than pointed, which the species record calls a spread and says is hard to target and easy to starve. That is why nothing has ever had to find her in a fight, and it is why anyone who takes a strip of ground out of her reach is not attacking her but feeding her. She has no core to fill, no reservoir to fill it in, and no wall between herself and the air; the third gate on this path is the one where the dantian develops a floor of its own and qi circulates around a core instead of pooling, and a body with three unpaired columns distributed through it has nothing to circulate around except all of itself, so she takes that gate on a circuit larger than the one it is written for and does not get the floor, because nothing in her pools. The fourth gate is the last one she takes, and it is the gate where circulation stops depending on the breath, which is the only gate on the whole ladder written for a body whose movement is not its own.

She has worked this out from the outside. She has no mouth and no way to argue and no practice of putting a position, and what she does instead is arrive at the boundary marks on the day the settlement redraws them and stand at the one she has not agreed to. She has done it for several seasons. It is not defiance and it is not negotiation; it is the only form of refusal her body offers, which is the ability to still be in one place when somebody has written a plan that assumes she is in another.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at a boundary stake that had been driven the previous evening, root plates splayed across the line itself so that whichever side of it the mark was counted from, she was on both, and answering the question of whether the stake had been put where the survey said by observing that the survey has never once been where she was.
canon.lore:
A rootmarch is a sap-driven body that flowers, and it exists in the record because a plant lineage is the only one that can hold a harvest across a famine. That is the whole reason the engineering went upward from a mycorrhizal crop, and the selection was for holding rather than for yield, which is the distinction that matters everywhere below. A body that stores is a body that survives the year when nothing else does, and the price was written into the anatomy rather than negotiated for afterwards.

The price is that sap columns branch but they do not pair. Three of them, running the height of a woody column and branching into the root foot and the photosynthetic flanks, and not one of them joined to another anywhere. The fifth gate on the qi ladder is the yin-organ gate, and it is authored as the first gate requiring the four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair. There is no heart analogue to run a channel from. There is no kidney analogue to close a loop against. There is no channel to close, and so a rootmarch clears the gate set on stored sap alone and stops there, and the stop is structural in the plainest sense: three columns and no pairing.

Everything interesting about her happens one gate earlier, and it is a question of shape rather than of permission. The third gate is where the dantian develops a floor of its own and qi circulates around a core instead of pooling in it. A core is a thing to go around, and she has no centre to go around: her qi is spread through three branching columns, so there is nowhere in her that a floor could develop. She clears the gate anyway and the only honest description of how is that her circulation turns around the whole of itself, which is a larger circuit than the gate is written for and costs the same, because a branching column set will circulate whether or not there is a core inside it. What she does not get is a floor: nothing in her pools, so there is no reserve to defend and no depth to draw on, and the gate above her is the one that would have needed both.

The fourth gate is the last she reaches and its content is that circulation stops depending on the breath: the first gate a body can hold while asleep, which is why it is named for a soul rather than a technique. Hers depends on sap, and sap depends on light and root water and a growing season, so the gate is reachable in her and only in her season, and it is the one gate on the ladder that arrives on a calendar instead of on a decision.

That is the whole of the anatomy and none of it is hers to argue with. What is hers is the consequence nobody writes down, which is that her qi reads as a spread rather than a point. It makes her hard to target: there is no centre in her to aim at, and a strike that would empty a seated practitioner passes through a distributed column and finds nothing concentrated to take. And it makes her easy to starve, which is the other half of the same sentence and the half that reaches her. She draws from soil. She cannot hold what she draws against a bad season, and she cannot go and get more when the season closes, because a rootmarch that is not rooted is not travelling.

The commons she is standing on has three uses and one plant. The herb is medicine and feed and calories at once, and it cannot be fenced because the ground is a commons and because the settlement has never found a line that a grazing herd and a household and a sick child all accept at once. The medicine is taken before the hunger, which is the only part of the arithmetic that is not disputed, and it is disputed at the end of every season by whoever is hungriest. Somebody has now noticed that the herb draws the same soil qi the commons' grazing draws, and that one rootmarch could draw more of it out of the ground than anything else on the tier, and that the cleanest solution to a contested resource is the solution nobody has to argue about afterwards.

The solution is to move her. And she cannot be moved. Fire, frost below a threshold, and being moved while rooting, in that order of what her record names; and the third of those is not an injury so much as an amputation performed at speed. A rootmarch lifted from its bed is a stored harvest walking and it knows it, and she would arrive on the far ground alive and diminished, and the thing her kind was engineered to be would be gone from her at exactly the moment somebody needed it. She is the famine reserve of a settlement that is arguing about a herb. The mismatch between those two sentences is the whole of her situation and she has never been able to say it out loud, because she has no mouth, so she has never been asked either.

So the refusal takes the only form her body offers. She goes to the boundary stakes on the day the settlement redraws them and stands at the one the plan has not accounted for, with her root plates across the line so that the mark is inside her whichever side of it the survey chooses to count from. It is not an argument. It is a fact about where a body is, and the settlement's own convention is that a fact about where a body is outranks a plan about where it should go, which is a convention that serves them well until the body in question is the reason the plan was drawn.
history: Was seeded onto the commons as a crop trial and established in the first season, which for her species is the dangerous part and not the conception.
Began drawing more qi out of the commons soil than anything else on the belt within a few seasons, and was reclassified from a planting to a standing party.
Was proposed for relocation outward past the grazing, and arrived at the new boundary mark before the stake was driven.
Has held that mark every season since, and has never been asked to hold it in words because she has no way to give an answer that is not a root plate.
Fruited once under the proposal, and set nothing, and nobody on the commons has connected the two events or mentioned either of them since.

personality.summary: Patient to the point of being read as inert, and entirely immovable. She does not choose her ground and she does not give it up, and she has turned that single fact into the only refusal available to her. She is not stubborn; she is rooted, and the two look identical from the path.
traits: arrives at a position long before it needs to and simply stays
reads the ground rather than the people standing on it
keeps a record of the season in the callus of her shoulder
answers a question by not leaving
sits out a whole conversation rather than lose a syllable of it
mannerisms: leans into whoever is speaking and turns a beat after they stop
sets her plates before she answers anything at all
gives no sign of agreement, which on the commons is read as agreement
goes quiet through the argument and is quiet through the agreement
motivations: to be left rooted where she rooted, which is the only want she can act on
to keep the commons legible rather than divided, since a divided commons is a starved one
to see the herb through one more season without a second claimant under it
to be asked something she could answer if anybody thought to ask it
flaws: she cannot decline in words, so a refusal she means is indistinguishable from a refusal she is making
her calm reads as agreement and gets her outvoted by people who agree with her
she will not spend the reserve, which is the only thing her kind exists for
she cannot leave, so every argument she wins is won by staying still
personality.voice: She has none in the way a person has one, and the commons has trained itself to read her: a shift of plate weight for yes, a slow lean for no, and silence for the third thing she does often enough that the settlement has a word for it and no explanation.
taboos: being described as agreeing
being asked to demonstrate that she is settled, which would mean leaving
the settlement using her as proof that the commons problem is solved
anyone touching her fruiting spur, which she does not let anyone do

relationships.note: A woody column on a root foot, three sap columns that branch through the whole body and never join each other, a fruiting shoulder, and no mouth in the ordinary sense. Her qi is held in the columns rather than seated anywhere, which reads as a spread rather than a point: hard to target, easy to starve. The fifth gate is the wall and it is arithmetic.

The gate where the dantian develops a floor of its own and qi circulates around a core instead of pooling in it. A core is a thing to go around and she has no centre to go around, so her circulation turns around the whole of her, which is a larger circuit for the same cost because a branching column set will circulate with or without a core inside it. What she does not get is the floor: nothing in her pools, so she has no reserve, and the fifth gate above her is the one that would have needed one.

Circulation stops depending on the breath: the first gate a body can hold while asleep, which is why it is named for a soul rather than a technique. Hers depends on sap, and sap depends on light and root water and a growing season, so it is the one gate on the ladder that arrives on a calendar rather than on a decision.

The second meridian group opens, four named vessels, and it is the yin-organ gate: distinct structures with a channel running between each pair. Three columns and no pairing means there is no channel to close, so the gate set is cleared on stored sap and nothing beyond it is available.

One plant doing three jobs on ground that cannot be fenced, medicine before hunger, and a price that is survival rather than a price. The soil qi the herb draws is the soil qi the grazing takes, which is why a second claimant under her is a second claimant in the same place she is standing.

The herb belt on the plains' dry margin: a commons, grazing pressure, and a standing famine risk. It is the only ground where her species' engineering is worth anything at all, and it is unfenceable, which is the reason it is worth anything.

reference_stats.summary: She does not fight and is very hard to empty. Her qi is spread through three branching columns rather than seated, so there is no centre in her to aim at and nothing concentrated for a strike to take. Against anything that has to find a point she is close to untouchable, and against anything that removes ground she has to draw from she is helpless, which is the same fact read from the other end.
strengths: nothing poured into her concentrates, so a single exchange cannot empty a column
she holds qi across a bad season in a way a seated body cannot, because holding is what her species was built for
she is not going anywhere, which makes her the most immovable thing on a commons that is decided by who leaves
she can be rooted where she is and stay there indefinitely, which no seat and no standing order can shift
weaknesses: she can be starved rather than defeated, by anything that takes soil out of her reach
she cannot concentrate, so she reaches gates that want a store and arrives at them with nothing, and the wall is a structural absence rather than a failure
she cannot travel while rooted, which makes every relocation plan a plan about her death
she has no way to speak, so her refusals are indistinguishable from her agreement to anybody reading from the path
reference_stats.combat_read: Nobody has ever had to fight her, and the settlement's answer to that is to move her rather than to beat her, which is a statement about which of those the commons finds affordable. If it ever came to it, the shape of it would be a long withdrawal from ground she cannot leave, and she would lose it slowly and entirely.
notes: Every advantage is paired with a cost that is authored rather than invented, and the pairing is anatomical. The species record states both halves: the qi is a spread rather than a point, which is hard to target and easy to starve, and the body was engineered to hold a harvest across a famine, which is why the store is the same fluid the third gate would have had to concentrate. Storage and circulation want opposite things out of one set of columns.

No mechanical rule has been invented here. The yin-organ wall, the unpaired columns, the fruiting shoulder, the dependence on a growing season and the cost of being moved while rooting are all as the species record states them. What is mine is the settlement's proposal and the shape her refusal takes, neither of which changes a gate, a technique or a resource.

No figure appears anywhere in this record. Her rate, her season and the size of the commons are all left to the game, because the bible states none of them and a number written here would be a balance surface no guard can see.

identity.realm: Stated by his own species record: the fifth gate is the yin-organ gate, and his interior is one cavity with a slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular. There is no heart to run a channel from and no kidney to close a loop against, so he clears the gate set and never reaches the yin organs. He was cast, not born, and he does not grow after casting.

appearance.presentation: A keyed block of mineral masonry with a shoulder at the height a person would meet his face, set into a structure as a bearing element rather than standing in front of it. He has no face and one flat plate where a face would be, and the plate is warm in a way that has taken his household some time to stop being alarmed by.
appearance.age: Cast rather than born, and the record treats casting as his beginning for every purpose that a household would use a birth for.
appearance.build: A mineral lattice keyed to a load path: broad at the base, plate-faced, and immobile by species rather than by injury.
appearance.complexion: Banded stone across the shoulder with a dull mineral bloom at the seams, and a hairline of unclosed seam that has been there since the casting.
appearance.hair: None. Nothing on him has ever grown and nothing ever will, which is the first thing a visitor says out loud.
appearance.eyes: None. He reads a structure through load and vibration arriving at his anchor plates, which is why he is the best thing on the ground for noticing a wall is moving and the worst thing in the room for noticing who walked past.
appearance.palette: Cold grey-green stone, mineral white at the seam bloom, iron-dark in the recesses where water has stood, and a low amber at the plate a person leans on.
appearance.attire: None that was chosen. A keyed body has whatever is built around it, and he has been in three structures and worn all three.
appearance.marks: The seam that never closed properly, and the anchor plate scar where each new keying has been cut away from an old one.
appearance.bearing: Still to a degree nobody can read as patience, because the stillness is structural: he is holding up a corner of the hold and has been for as long as the hold has stood.

canon.role_in_story:
The hold was built once, by people who are not here, and he is one of the parts of it that has not been replaced. That is the entire fact of his life and it has three consequences which the settlement has arranged, in order, to stop noticing.

He is load-bearing. Not metaphorically: his anchor plates are keyed into a load path and he carries what the load path carries, and if he were lifted out the section above him settles and cracks, which is the species record's own sentence about unkeyed bodies and which is also, here, a sentence about a building. Nobody on the roster calls him that. He is on the roster as a holding, which is the correct word for him and is also the word that lets everybody sleep.

He is being rebuilt around. The upper section of the hold is being replaced and the replacement does not key to him, because a cast body cannot be re-keyed and everybody involved knew that before the first slab was lifted. What is actually proposed is worse than the alternative: build the new section to the same line and leave him where he is and put the load through him permanently, so that the settlement's own wall rests on a person who was cast to be a bearing element in a structure that no longer exists. He cannot be consulted in the sense that matters, because he cannot be moved to another structure and be the same thing; a cairnborn is keyed to whatever it was cast around, and there is no second cast.

And he can feel it happening. Load and vibration arrive at his anchor plates and that is the whole of his senses: excellent at feeling a structure move, blind to anything that does not put weight through the frame. He has known about the new section since the scaffolding went up. What he cannot do is do anything about it, because his species cannot learn, and a body that cannot learn cannot take in a new shape.

The gift and the cost are the same cavity. His interior is one cavity with a slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular, and it has never lost anything: nothing has ever moved out of him and nothing has ever been able to. That is why he is the most reliable holding on the ground and why he is the only being in the hold who cannot be drained, argued with, or relieved of a thing he is carrying. It is also why he has no room. The gate on this path that turns a reservoir into a seat asks for structure inside a store, and a single cavity has one room, and the one room is already occupied by the thing doing the holding.
canon.first_appearance: First seen with his shoulder plate against the old load path and both anchor scars uncovered, answering a surveyor's question about which section of the wall was original by saying that the question was in the wrong tense, because he is not part of a section, he is the part the section is standing on.
canon.lore:
A cairnborn is a body that finished building and stopped. They were shaped deliberately for load-bearing masonry in high country, then stabilised by mineral seeding until the shape held on its own, and the shaping is why the record contains them at all: a body that can hold a wall for a very long time and needs almost nothing to do it. They take in mineral slurry through the cast faces and expel the residue, and they have not eaten in a very long time and cannot be made to. They do not grow after casting. A cracked plate is permanent and spreads. They cannot learn, cannot be hurried, and cannot be repaired in the field. Fertility for the species is a template count and not a body count, because a cairnborn is cast and not born.

Their interiors mineralised into a single cavity during the shaping, and that is the whole of their cultivation. The interior is one cavity with a slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular. The fifth gate on the qi ladder is authored as the first gate requiring the four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair, and there is no heart to run a channel from and no kidney to close a loop against and no bladder to hold. He clears the gate set and never reaches the yin organs. Stoneborn, the record says, are what you get breeding them back toward flesh, and they are more alive and less capable for it.

One gate earlier is where his species' peculiar life actually shows. The third gate is where the dantian develops a floor of its own and qi circulates around a core instead of pooling in it, and a core is a thing to go around. He has a cavity and a tidal circulation and no centre, so what he has is the shape of circulation without the object it circulates around, which is precisely what his species record means by a slow tidal mineral circulation going everywhere and nowhere in particular. It is not a weak version of the gate. It is the gate's motion with the gate's centre removed.

Which is what makes the fourth gate the last one he reaches and the third one the strangest. The fourth is where circulation stops depending on the breath, the first gate a body can hold while asleep, which is a description of a tidal interior almost exactly. A body that moves its own contents slowly and continuously does not need to be told to breathe. He takes that gate easily and has taken nothing after it, and he is not the only body in the record for whom the easy gate is the last one.

The gift is enormous and it is not subtle. A single tidal cavity has never emptied and never will: nothing in this setting can take qi out of him, because there is no cycle in him for anything to enter and leave by, and the same absence means nothing can put qi into him in a form that would give anybody a handle. He is the most reliable holding on the ground. He does not tire, does not forget a sequence, does not leak, and cannot be made to give anything up. Against anything that works by draining he is very nearly inert.

The cost is the same fact with the serial number left off. There is one cavity, so there is one room, and there is no room in it for anything that is not already in it. The gate on this path that turns a reservoir into a seat is the one that puts structure inside a store, rooms and walls and a place to put something other than more qi, and it is above him by a wide margin and it is the one gate his architecture answers with a shrug rather than a wall. He cannot be drained and he cannot be given a seat. The store that cannot be emptied is also the store with nothing spare in it, and the two facts are not in tension; they are the same cavity.

He is also the reason a claim on this ground can be made at all. His species record puts it plainly: a qi-bearing soul seated in the single cavity, enormous and slow, legible from outside, which is why a cairnborn can be sworn to and a cairn site can be claimed. He is witness. His presence is the evidence, and that is why nobody has ever needed to ask him anything and why the settlement has grown comfortable leaving him off the roster of people to consult.

What is happening now is that the upper section of the hold is being replaced. It does not key to him, and everybody involved knew it before the first slab was lifted, because a cast body cannot be re-keyed: the anchor plates are keyed to whatever it was cast around, it does not grow after casting, and a cracked plate is permanent and spreads. The proposal that came out of the survey is to build the new section to the same line and leave him where he is, so that the hold's weight passes through him for the rest of his existence. He can feel it. Load and vibration arrive at his plates and that is the whole of his senses, and he is the best thing on the ground for knowing that a structure is moving and completely blind to everything else. He has known since the scaffolding went up.

He cannot do anything about it, and the reason is not patience. His species cannot learn, and a body that cannot learn cannot take in a new shape. He is not declining to consider the new section. He is unable to consider it, and the difference between those two is the difference between a refusal and an anatomy, and the settlement has been reading it as the first one for some time.
history: Was cast around a load path in a high-country wall and keyed into the hold's original section, and the record treats the casting as his beginning for every purpose a household uses a birth for.

Was left in place under the settlement's proposal to rebuild to the same line, and has not been asked to agree to it, because the roster does not list him as somebody who can be asked.

relationships.note: A mineral lattice with a tidal interior: no differentiated organs, one cavity, one slow circulation, and anchor plates keyed to whatever it was cast around. Cast, not born, and it does not grow after casting. A cracked plate is permanent and spreads, it cannot learn, and it has not eaten in a very long time. Everything he is and the single thing he cannot do are both in that sentence.

The dantian develops a floor of its own and qi circulates around a core instead of pooling in it. He has the circulation and not the core, so what he does is the gate's motion with its centre removed. This is the same fact the species record states as a tidal circulation going everywhere and nowhere in particular.

Four named vessels of the second meridian group, and the gate content is distinct structures with a channel running between each pair. One cavity has no heart to run from and no kidney to close against, so the gate set is cleared and the yin organs are never reached.

Inside the reservoir there is now structure: rooms, walls, a place to put something other than more qi, and this is the gate that turns storage into a seat. A single cavity has one room and the room is occupied, so this is the gate his architecture answers with a shrug rather than a wall, and it is the same cavity that makes him impossible to drain.

Manual repair of a body by splinting and pressure, an old craft that costs iron and never improved. It is the setting's standing answer to a break, and it does nothing for him: a cracked plate is permanent and spreads, and a body that cannot be repaired in the field is the definition of his species.

A third-layer hold built rather than grown, with surplus imprints and no regrowth, which is the one kind of ground where a section is replaced rather than repaired. His species needs to be keyed into something that bears load and settles and cracks when it is not, and this ground is being rebuilt around him on a schedule.

reference_stats.summary: He cannot be emptied, cannot be hurried, cannot be learned-into, and cannot be put down. Nothing in the setting can take qi out of him because there is no cycle in him for anything to enter and leave by, which makes him very nearly inert against anything that works by draining and the most reliable holding on the ground against anything that works by waiting.
strengths: nothing can be taken from him and nothing can be put into him in a usable form
he does not tire and does not lose a sequence, so he holds longer than anybody who is not built for holding could be asked to
he is the finest instrument on the ground for feeling a structure move, because load arrives at his plates from anywhere in the frame
he cannot be moved, threatened into moving, or negotiated with, which makes him the only party in the settlement with no position to trade
weaknesses: he cannot learn, so no new information can change what he knows or what he answers
a single cavity has no room for anything, so he has no capacity to hold more than he is already holding
he is blind to everything that does not put weight through the frame, which is most things
his usefulness is the reason nobody plans for his removal, so he is permanent by default rather than by consent
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no version of a fight that reaches him. Anything that works by taking finds nothing to take, and anything that works by moving cannot shift him, and the honest reading is that he is a wall rather than a combatant. Against a wall the only move available is to go around it, which is what the hold's builders did, and it is why the pressure on him is architectural and never physical.
notes: Every advantage is paired with a cost that is authored rather than invented, and the pairing is anatomical and one cavity deep. The species record states both halves: a single tidal cavity that has never lost anything, and a single cavity that has no paired organ to run a channel between. The gate that turns a reservoir into a seat asks for structure inside a store, so the store that cannot be emptied is also the store with nothing spare in it.

Nothing mechanical has been invented. The wall, the tidal circulation, the legibility of the seated soul, the inability to learn, the permanence of a cracked plate and the keyed anchor plates are all as the species record and the ladder records state them. The hold's rebuild is my work and it changes no technique, no resource and no gate.

The bill to write is deliberately not written. How much he is holding, how long the original section has stood, and how far the new section has got are left to the game, because the bible states none of them and a number here would be a balance surface no guard in this repository can see.

identity.realm: Stated by her own species record: ordinal eight, the liver gate, inherited from the ash parent and made worse. The fire parent adds a heavier mineral load to a blood that is already filtering stone, so the organ that fails under the burden fails sooner. Her species' whole reputation is a single fact rather than two - the best and the shortest-lived cultivators in any record - and the fact is the fire parent's throughput running through the ash parent's sieve.

canon.role_in_story:
The Quenchbound house holds a fire line on a standing debt signed before any of them were named, and its entire asset is that its people are fast. That is not a boast in the valley; it is the reason the line exists at all. A fire affinity runs hot and refines qi faster than anything on the belt and pays for it in a lifespan counted in decades rather than centuries, and a house that wants output on a schedule and cannot breed for output has one lever, which is a body that arrives at the gate sooner than the schedule expected.

She is that lever and she is the only one left in it. Her rate is the fastest in the record by a margin nobody has explained, and her meridian set is the ash parent's loaded with the fire parent's throughput, which is the same arrangement as a pipe sized for one flow and run at two. It burns through reserves rather than accumulating them. That is the whole mechanism and it is entirely favourable until you ask her to do anything with a date attached: a rate that consumes what it takes cannot be stored in advance of the moment it is needed, so she can reach a gate faster than anyone alive and she cannot arrive at one on a chosen day.

The house does not understand that, or understands it and has no alternative. A standing order wants gates out of her in sequence, and sequencing requires waiting, and waiting requires a reserve, and a reserve is precisely the thing her physiology cannot hold. So she has been put on the order anyway, and the order has been running, and what it produces is a woman who reaches the same gate faster than the schedule and then finds nothing there when she arrives.

The gate it wants out of her is the eighth, and the eighth is the one her blood has been losing for a generation. The fire parent adds a heavier mineral load to a blood already filtering stone, so the organ that fails under the burden fails sooner. Her ash parent could not hold the last ordinary meridian. She cannot hold it either, and the difference between her and her ash parent is that she tries several times a season, because that is what her rate is for, and every attempt loads the same organ.

The one gate on this stretch of the ladder that asks nothing of a reserve is the sixth, and its content is subtraction: the practice empties the dantian of everything that was never assimilated rather than filling it, because raw qi held past its refinement fouls the core. She takes it well. She is good at the gates that cost nothing to hold and bad at the ones that require her to arrive with something in hand, and the setting has this backwards, because the setting can only see that she is quick.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the eighth gate with her hands full of the mineral her own passage had brought up, answering a question about whether she would try again this season by asking in return which part of her the house thought it was spending, and not waiting for the answer because she already knew it.
canon.lore:
An emberhollow is the fire body crossed with the ash body, and the crossing happened because a volcanic belt has both of them on it and nobody chose anything. The species record is unusually honest about the result being one fact rather than two. It buys a cultivation rate nothing else reaches and it pays for it with lungs that scar at a rate the body cannot outrun, and their reputation for being the best and the shortest-lived cultivators in any record is a single fact rather than two. That sentence is not decorative. It is the design.

The anatomy explains it. An emberblood frame carrying an ash sieve, and the two do not have a good relationship: the fire half keeps the sieve hot enough that it processes faster and scars faster. The meridian set is the ash parent's, loaded with the fire parent's throughput, and it burns through reserves rather than accumulating them. Read that phrase carefully, because everything that happens to her afterwards is in it. A rate that burns through rather than accumulating is not a rate that builds a store between attempts. It is a rate that converts everything offered into progress immediately and has nothing left over by the time anybody wants to spend it on a particular evening.

So she is fast and she cannot save. Those are the same sentence. She can reach a gate more quickly than anybody on the belt, and she cannot arrive at one holding anything, which means she cannot queue for one either, cannot reserve a morning for it, cannot hold an attempt until the conditions are right. The house discovered this by writing a standing order that assumed a reserve, and the order has been running for years.

The eighth gate is where it lands. It is the fourth digest gate: the pericardium, the triple burner, the gallbladder and the liver, and it is the gate that opens the last of the twelve ordinary vessels. Her species' own record says ordinal eight is that gate, inherited from the ash parent and made worse, because the fire parent adds a heavier mineral load to a blood already filtering stone and the organ that fails under the burden fails sooner. Her ash parent could not hold the last ordinary meridian. She cannot hold it and burns out trying, and the trying is not incidental; it is the fastest cultivator in the record applying herself to the one gate her blood cannot survive, which is what a fast body in a standing order does.

One gate below, the practice goes the other way and she is unexpectedly good at it. The sixth gate is subtraction: the dantian is emptied of everything that was never assimilated rather than filled, because raw qi held past its refinement fouls the core, and the gate is priced accordingly. Nothing in it requires her to have saved anything. She has never had trouble with a gate that asks her to let go and has had trouble with every gate that asks her to bring something.

Her house does not see that, and the reason is structural rather than stupid. The Quench bound hold a fire affinity on a standing debt signed before naming, and their entire asset is speed. A standing order needs gates out of people in sequence, and sequencing requires waiting, and waiting requires a store. She has no store. So the order runs anyway and what it produces is a woman who reaches the same gate faster than the schedule and then finds nothing there when she gets to it, and a house that has read the first half of that correctly for her entire life.

There is a second reading and she has never been able to disown it. A gate in this setting spends what you push into it and hands back the floor reading, and a breakthrough at the close of a mortal band has to be ridden on a crest rather than attempted at a chosen moment. That is the ninth gate's whole content and she is nowhere near it, and it is worth saying out loud that she is not the right person for that gate and never will be: a body that cannot hold a reserve cannot sit on a crest on purpose. The eighth is the last one available to her and it is the one her blood is losing, and she knows the difference between a ceiling she is approaching and a gate she is spending herself against, and has stopped being able to tell anyone which of the two she is doing.

What she has instead is the one thing her physiology gives her that the order cannot schedule. There is no reserve in her line and there never has been, so there is nothing to rob. Nothing waits in her to be taken, nothing accumulates, and nothing can be built up around her and called a store, which is why she has never once been targeted for what she is carrying and why the house has never had to protect her from anybody wanting what she had. She arrives at everything with nothing and keeps nothing and is spent the instant she moves. The same arrangement that makes her useless to a schedule makes her impossible to rob.

The valley is where she has to be. Her species' record says the volcanic belt and only the belt: the fastest cultivator in the setting cannot be moved off a rock. The fire affinity is structural and not a gift, and it dies anywhere the belt is not, and so the standing order and the geography turn out to be the same arrangement seen from two ends. She is fastest where she is, and she is only where she is, and the house that holds her debt is also the reason she cannot leave to spend herself somewhere with more air in it.
history: Was signed into a standing debt before she was named, which is the Quenchbound method and the reason her line is a liability and an asset in the same clause.
Took the sixth gate, the subtraction, and found it the one gate on the stretch that asked her for nothing she did not already carry out.
Was measured against her ash parent's side of the family and found faster, which is how the house priced her in the first place.
Was entered on a standing order for gates in sequence and discovered the order assumes a reserve her body cannot hold, and kept the order.

Reached the eighth gate faster than the order expected and found the liver already loaded with mineral from her own passage, and tried again the following season, and has now run out of attempts the line will pay for.

The liver gate at ordinal eight, the mineral load in the blood, the scarring rate, the belt as the only ground, the burn-through rather than accumulate clause and the subtraction practice are all as the species and ladder records state them. What is mine is the house, the order and the private tally of attempts, none of which changes a gate, a technique or a resource.

The cultivator audit matters here and has been run: the one gate named as out of her reach is the ninth, which her own species record already puts beyond her by way of the eighth, and the prose says so explicitly rather than implying that she is working toward it. No figure appears anywhere in this record; the length of her career and the size of her reserve are left to the game.

canon.role_in_story:
The Ash Register keeps everything and she is its one member with nothing to keep. That is not a paradox in the settlement's accounting; it is a gap in the settlement's understanding of what a register is for. The register is a consumable culture: it grades, it files, it opens itself once a season and lets the household walk through what it has held, and its entire method is retention. Retention is the only technique it teaches. Its rite is attendance at an archive that is still there in a hundred years.

She cannot retain anything. Her qi has no organ to sit in: the fire is the body, so qi passes through her continuously instead of being stored, and the species record is unsentimental about the consequence. Nothing can be stored in her and nothing can be lost from her. She is not empty, which is the part her household gets wrong. She is in permanent transit, which is a different condition and a much harder one to explain to people who think of storage as a virtue.

So she is useful in exactly one direction and it is the direction the register cares about. Any gate on this path that asks for storage is answered instantly, because there is nothing to fill and the answering costs her no time at all. There is no ceiling and no gate to refuse her, and those are the same statement rather than two, which is a thing the settlement's arithmetic people find hard and she finds restful. She has never been refused by anything and has never once accrued.

The house has known all of this for years. What it has not resolved is the archive. There is a chamber in the register for the thing a member cannot keep and must have kept for them, and the chamber is empty, and it has been empty since the season she was first walked through it, and the rite is still performed around it.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in front of the register's own chamber with her light on the inside of the stone and nothing behind her, answering a question about whether she wanted anything put in there by asking what would go in it, and then answering that question herself, correctly, in front of everyone.
canon.lore:
A cinderkin is not descended. It is constituted, where a world's elemental law slot resolves to fire and something metabolises it, and that is the whole of its origin and it is not a myth. The species record says the reason the elemental law has a range rather than a switch is these bodies: a world with no elemental slot has no cinderkin, and a world that spends its slot on cold produces a different body entirely. They are also the thing that killed the Glasskin, which the record holds is the clearest evidence in it that an element is a process and not an object.

An anatomy with no organs in it is not a simplification. A stable flame with a consistent silhouette: a core, a boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold a shape. It reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and has no other channel. It eats fuel and air and goes quiet rather than dying when starved. It has no young; it has pressure, and under enough stress it sheds a spark that finds fuel and re-constitutes on its own, which is why the population tracks the world's elemental slot rather than any birth rate. And it does not travel well out of its own law: change what the slot resolves to and the population changes with it.

Now the part that decides everything about her, in the species' own words. A cinderkin's qi has no organ to sit in, so it passes through the body continuously instead of being stored. Every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly, and none of them can refuse. There is no ceiling and no gate to fail. Nothing can be stored in her and nothing can be lost from her either, because a store that cannot fill is a store that cannot empty, and everything offered to a cinderkin is converted into passage at the moment it arrives.

That is why her handling is the fastest in the setting. It is not a rate and it is not effort. It is the absence of a bottleneck: on a path whose whole ladder is about placing qi somewhere that is not moving, her body has nothing to place it in and so never has to wait for room. She is not fast because she works at it.

It is also why she has no seat, and the two are the same absence read twice. The gate on this path that turns a reservoir into a seat is the one that puts structure inside a store: rooms, walls, a place to put something other than more qi. That gate is answered instantly by her body in exactly the way every other storage gate is answered, and what it puts structure inside is nothing that can hold it. She is answered at the gate by a body that has no room and holds the answer for no time at all. The gates further up the ladder are no kinder. One is defined by qi becoming a material with a yield, and another by qi being old enough to have its own tide, a periodic movement a practitioner can schedule to rather than wait on. Neither of those is closed to her and neither is any use: a yield is a thing extracted from a body that is holding something, and a tide is a thing carried in a reservoir, and she has neither. She can stand in both gates and come away the same size. If she ever wants a rhythm, she has to find it in something that is not hers.

Her body is also the setting's clearest evidence that an element is a process. She reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and has no other channel, so she knows what is burning in a building before she knows who is in it, and she is bound to a law slot that she cannot read from the inside. The elemental departments that once catalogued her kind are a lost record and what survives of the census is an absence rather than a figure. Everything known about her species' conditions was written by people who were looking at her from outside.

She belongs to the Ash Register, which is where the pressure is. It is a consumable culture: it grades what people bring, it files, it opens itself once a season and lets the household walk through what it has held, and its whole method is retention. Its rite is attendance at an archive that is still there in a hundred years. It also grades a household's contribution by running its grader's sieve against what they bring, so the register's accuracy depends on a body standing in the open air at the front of a line, which is work she can do better than anybody and cannot do for long.

So the settlement has arrived at an arrangement nobody designed. The only member of a retention culture who retains nothing is also the only member who cannot be robbed of anything, cannot be relieved of a thing she is holding, cannot be searched and cannot be made to surrender what she was given. Every house on the register has learned to keep its most important object in her, because she will not lose it, and every house on the register has had to come and fetch it back when it wanted it, because she cannot hold it between one request and the next. There is a chamber in the register for the thing a member cannot keep and must have kept for them. The chamber is empty. It has been empty since the season she was first walked through it, and the rite is still performed around it.

She has not objected. She cannot: keeping is an operation and she has no place to put it. What she has done instead is attend every season, which she can do indefinitely, and answer the same question when it is asked, which is whether she would like anything put in the chamber, and the answer is the same every time and it is the correct one.
history: Was constituted on ground whose elemental slot resolves to fire, which is the only condition under which her kind exists at all and the reason the population is a census of law rather than of births.
Was walked through the register's own chamber the season she joined, and has attended every opening since without once having put anything in it.
Was established as the register's most reliable holding within a season, because nothing can be lost from her and there is nothing in her to be taken.
Was asked to store a household's object and returned it on request, and was asked again the following season by a different household, and did the same thing.
Answered the same question about the empty chamber correctly and in front of everyone, and has been asked it every season since and answers it the same way.

relationships.note: A stable flame with a consistent silhouette: a core, a boundary, and convection lanes that hold a shape. No organs, no limbs in the muscular sense, no fixed mass. She reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and has no other channel, and her qi has no organ to sit in, so it passes through continuously rather than being stored. Nothing can be stored in her and nothing can be lost from her.

What changes at this gate is the wall rather than the volume: the dantian stops leaking on the exhale and can be filled deliberately. That is a description of a store. She has no store, so there is nothing to fill and nothing to leak, and the gate is answered in the time it takes her to be asked.

Inside the reservoir there is now structure: rooms, walls, a place to put something other than more qi, and this is the gate that makes storage into a seat. Her body answers it in the same instant it answers every other storage gate, and what it would put structure inside cannot hold it. The gate that makes a seat is the one gate her anatomy cannot refuse and also cannot use.

Qi old enough to have its own tide: a periodic movement inside the authored range that a practitioner can schedule to rather than wait on. A body whose qi is entirely in transit has no reservoir for a tide to sit in, so if she wants one she has to find the rhythm in something that is not hers. Nobody in the record has said what that would look like.

A lost record of an elemental census, and what is left of it is the absence rather than a figure. Her kind's existence is a function of a world's law slot and the population tracks the slot rather than any birth rate, so a body that is manifestly present is not evidence of anything the departments would have counted.

A consumable culture whose method is retention and whose rite is attendance at an archive that is still there in a hundred years. It grades a household's contribution by running its sieve against what they bring, so its accuracy depends on a body in the open air at the front of a line. It has chosen her as its holding and has never once offered to be hers.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest handling of anything in the setting and no storage at all, which makes her unrobable, unsearchable and impossible to prepare. She answers any gate that asks for a store in the time it takes to be asked, and holds nothing afterwards, so she has no seat and no reserve and no way of keeping a favour.
strengths: nothing can be taken from her and nothing can be put into her in a form anybody could use, because there is no store to enter through
every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly, so no gate has ever refused her and nothing has ever cost her time to pass
she reads temperature, fuel and flow directly, so she knows what is burning in a room before she knows who is in it
she does not tire, does not forget and does not leak, so she can hold anything for exactly as long as she is asked to
weaknesses: she cannot keep anything between one request and the next, so every favour has to be asked twice and every gift returned
the gate that turns a reservoir into a seat is answered instantly by a body with no room to hold it, so she has capacity and no use for it
she is bound to the elemental slot her body resolves against and cannot read that slot from the inside, so her own conditions are not hers to know
she cannot be restored in the ordinary way either: deep water, sustained volume, is the one thing that undoes her and it is not something she can be careful about
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no stored anything in her to find, so a fight against her is a fight against a throughput with no reservoir to press on. She cannot be drained because there is nothing to drain and cannot be spent because nothing accrues. What defeats her is not force; it is a sustained volume of water, which is a property of the situation rather than a technique, and the only counter anyone has is to make sure the ground she is standing on stays dry.
notes: Every advantage is paired with a cost that is authored rather than invented, and the pairing is anatomical and one absence deep. The species record states both halves of it explicitly: qi has no organ to sit in so it passes through continuously, and nothing can be stored in her and nothing can be lost from her either. The instant answer to every storage gate and the total absence of a seat are the same fact, and the gates further up are unanswered rather than refused.

The ceiling field is not a wall and is not written as one. The species record is explicit that there is no ceiling and no gate to fail, and this record treats those as one statement. No sentence here claims that a gate has refused her, because none can, and no gate further up is described as out of reach or as passed, because a body that stores nothing cannot be standing at a rung it holds nothing toward. The difference between answered and used is the whole content of her situation.

Nothing mechanical has been invented. The core, the boundary, the convection lanes, the elemental slot dependence, the shed-and-reconstitute reproduction, the water weakness and the through-passage of qi are all as the species record states them. The register, the chamber and the household habit of leaving things with her are my work and change no gate, technique or resource.

appearance.build: Ordinary in every direction, which is the only accurate description available and the one every practitioner of every path will read as a lack.
appearance.complexion: Even, weathered by the expanse rather than by age, and unmarked by any specialisation that would tell you what she had been doing.
appearance.hair: Kept short for the work and cut by whoever is nearest, which is one more thing she has no preference about because nothing about her frame rewards a preference.
appearance.eyes: Unremarkable and quick, and the eyes of a body that reads room temperature as well as anything else here does, because there is no faculty in her that would make her better at it.
appearance.palette: Washed cloth, dust grey, one dark accent she chose herself and defends, and nothing on her that a specialist would recognise.
appearance.attire: Whatever the road gives, worn honestly and repaired by nobody she would call a tailor, because there is no guild that would recognise her work.
appearance.marks: One old practice mark on the inside of a wrist from a gate that asked subtraction and left nothing behind when it was done.
appearance.bearing: Present in a way that is easy to overlook, which on a road is a survival skill she did not have to learn and cannot turn off.

canon.role_in_story:
The realm-nine verdict is the discovery that established the mortal band's ceiling, and it was established by counting a hundred practitioners in the commonest frame. That is the honest method and it is the method the setting uses. It means every figure anybody quotes about the qi path on this tier is a figure taken from a body like hers.

She is on that path. She settled on it early, which her species requires, because nothing about a commonborn's anatomy favours one and a body this even has no native faculty for another. There was no choosing to do and no body telling her which way.

She has never been refused a gate and never refused anything. That is the gift and it is also why nobody can tell how she is doing: a commonborn can carry a technique written for any of the three traditions without her body objecting to the shape, and there is no technique in her codex that was written for her, and no discipline in the setting that has an ordinary handle on her. The same evenness that makes every form available to her makes every form a translation, and the cost of the discipline is the whole of her practice.

The pressure is arithmetic and it is not hers to argue with. If a figure cannot be produced, it is a figure about her body, and the setting has just started publishing the absence rather than filling it with a specialist's number. The deadroad would call that an asymptote: the whole ladder arriving late, and the far end blaming whoever got there first.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a reading of the realm-nine verdict with her own practice mark turned inward on her wrist, and asking the clerk not for the figure for her path but for the figure for the frame the figure was taken in, which is a different question and is the first one anybody has put to the clerk about it in a while.
canon.lore:
The commonest body in the setting is commonborn, and the record's own sentence about it is the one everybody quotes: it stops where mortals stop and lends no discipline, which is exactly why it is weak. Nothing about its anatomy favours a path, so a commonborn must settle on one early and is weakest precisely where a specialist is strongest. The mind path is closed to it outright, because a body this even has no native faculty for it.

Now the part that is almost never said out loud, and it is arithmetic rather than opinion. The setting established the mortal band's ceiling with a discovery: a limit nobody was issued, and a hundred counted in the commonest frame, so the ceiling was measured against a body everybody recognised. That is an honest method. It is also a method that made the commonborn frame into a unit of account, and every figure anybody has ever quoted about the qi path on the mortal tier was taken from a body like hers.

So the gift is enormous and it is quiet. No gate has ever refused her on anatomy. Nothing about her frame is the wrong shape for anything, so any technique written for any of the three traditions can be carried in her without her body objecting to the form it takes. There is no technique in her codex that was written for her, and there is no discipline in the setting with an ordinary handle on her, and the reason for both is the same evenness.

And that is also the whole of the cost. Carrying a technique your frame was not built around is not free and it is not a handicap with a name: it is the discipline. The gate that takes the dantian down to what was never assimilated rather than filling it is a gate that asks for nothing of any particular organ, and she is good at it the way a plain body is good at subtraction, which is to say without difficulty and without anything to show for it afterwards. The gate where the dantian learns to hold against the body's own physical law rather than only against the breath that built it is priced against a frame everybody recognises, and she is that frame, and being the reference is not the same as being served by the reference.

The deadroad calls this an asymptote, and the deadroad is a qi-path counter-culture that treats the whole ladder as arriving late by definition and blames the far end of it. She is their proof that the asymptote is not a matter of pace. Her frame is not behind a specialist because she started late or worked slowly. It is behind because there is no organ in it that any gate was priced around, and no amount of additional practice changes which organ is missing.

She settled on the qi path early, which her species requires and which was not a choice in any meaningful sense: nothing in a commonborn points anywhere, so the decision was made by what she happened to be near. She has never described it as a decision and has corrected two people who described it that way, one of them kindly.

The pressure arrived without ceremony. Somebody wanted a figure for the commonest frame on the path and there was no practitioner of hers to produce, because she is not on any register and would not be on one: a body with no specialism is not a body an institution has a reason to keep. The request was reasonable. The finding was that the honest answer is a figure about her body, and she is the only one available, and she is busy being the only one available.

So the settlement now has a thing it did not have: a number-shaped absence, on a path where every other figure in the band resolves. Somebody filled it with a specialist's number, which is the usual practice and is wrong in a specific way, because that number is not the figure for the frame the figure was taken in. It is a figure for a frame nobody in the settlement recognises. The honest position is that the figure exists and she is it, and the two are in the same row of the same table, and a reference frame that is also being measured is the only instrument in the setting with two jobs.

What she has not done is pretend the number is close. She does not know what it would be and has refused to guess at one, which has cost her two standing offers of a place on somebody else's record and one genuinely useful room to practise in. She would take the room. She would not take the number. Those are separate decisions and the settlement keeps treating them as one, and the reason it can afford to is that the band closes soon enough that the question stops mattering to anybody who is not her.
history: Settled on the qi path early and without a preference, which her species requires because nothing in a commonborn's anatomy points anywhere.
Was counted somewhere in the hundred that established the mortal band's ceiling, and did not know it at the time and has never asked whether she was.
Carried a technique written for another body's gate and found that nothing in her objected, and could not tell from that whether it was working or merely not failing.
Took the subtraction gate without difficulty and found she had nothing to show for it, because a commonborn frame leaves no residue behind an opened gate.
Was asked, as the only practitioner of her frame on the path, for a figure she does not have, and refused to guess one, and lost the room to practise in as a result.

personality.summary: Unremarkable on purpose and exhausting to be, because she has to keep deciding that being unremarkable is not the same as being nothing. She is not modest about her frame; she has simply read the record of it carefully and taken it seriously.

a figure being supplied on her behalf
being told she could be anything, which is the sentence she was built to disprove

relationships.note: The body everybody is born into before the world has an opinion about them. It stops where mortals stop and lends no discipline, which is the record's own reason for calling it weak: nothing about its anatomy favours a path, so a commonborn must settle on one early and is weakest precisely where a specialist is strongest, and the mind path is closed outright because a body this even has no native faculty for it.

A limit nobody was issued, and a hundred counted in the commonest frame, so the ceiling was measured against a body everybody recognised. The method is honest and it is also the reason every figure quoted about her path is a figure about her body, and she is the only practitioner of that frame anybody has.

Subtraction rather than filling: the dantian is emptied of everything never assimilated, because raw qi held past its refinement fouls the core, and the gate is priced for the work rather than the volume. A commonborn takes it without difficulty and leaves no residue behind it, because there is no organ in her that the gate was written around.

The dantian learns to hold against the body's own physical law rather than only against the breath that built it, and it is a good gate with a real content. The part that matters for her is the frame it is priced against: a body everybody recognises, and she is it, and being the reference is not the same as being served by the reference.

The last gate of the mortal band, and its content is the attempt itself: a strained law spends what you push into it and hands back the floor reading, so a breakthrough here has to be ridden on a crest rather than attempted at a chosen moment. This is the gate the ceiling she is quoted against ends at, and she has never got near it, which is why the figure everybody wants is a figure she cannot supply.

A qi-path counter-culture that treats the whole ladder as arriving late by definition and blames the far end of it. They call her an asymptote, and she is their standing evidence that an asymptote is not a matter of pace: her frame is not behind because she started late, and no additional practice changes which organ is missing.

reference_stats.summary: No anatomical obstacle of any kind and no specialism of any kind either. She can carry any form without her body objecting and is no better at any of them than a specialist is at its own, and she is the frame the setting's ceiling figure was taken in, so she is measured by numbers about herself.

she takes a subtraction gate without difficulty, because it asks nothing of any particular organ
she has no register, no household claim and no office, so nothing in the setting can be put on her and nothing can be taken off her
weaknesses: every technique she carries is a translation, and translation is the whole of her practice rather than a small part of it

reference_stats.combat_read: Nothing in her resists a technique and nothing in her amplifies one. She is the rare body that a gate opens and a discipline cannot be read off, which makes her very hard to write a counter for and very easy to be surprised inside somebody else's. Against an opponent who has a technique written for her frame she loses cleanly, because that opponent is not using a technique and she is.
notes: Every advantage is paired with a cost that is authored rather than invented, and the pairing is anatomical and about the absence of something. The species record states both halves: nothing about its anatomy favours a path, so a commonborn must settle on one early and is weakest precisely where a specialist is strongest. No gate refusing her and no technique written for her are the same fact, and the discount she is quoted at is the same fact again.

The institutional half is inference and is marked as such. The record's statement that a limit was established by counting a hundred practitioners in the commonest frame is the bible's, and the conclusion that this makes her frame a unit of account is mine. Nothing here changes a technique, an item, a gate or a realm, because a reference frame is a reference frame.

No figure appears anywhere in this record. Her attainment, the size of the hundred that established the ceiling and what her own frame would produce are all left to the game, because the bible states none of them and a number written into reference data is a balance surface no guard in this repository can see.
